name: New Orleans
about: Mardi Gras (dates shift with the Easter calendar, typically Feb) is the single busiest, most chaotic stretch of the year; summer (Jun–Sep) is brutally hot, humid, and carries real hurricane risk.
overview: The birthplace of jazz, Creole and Cajun cooking, French Quarter architecture, and Mardi Gras — one of America's most distinctive food and music cities.
costOverview: Po'boys and streetcar rides are cheap even in the touristy French Quarter — fine dining and Bourbon Street nightlife are where the real spending happens.
